approval.basis: User explicitly requested product breakdown, repository updates and mapping of these existing five editorials; no new editorial generated.

copy.captionKo: 카멜 울 재킷과 차콜 크루넥에 레드 머플러 하나를 더해요. 브라운 팬츠와 다크 브라운 앵클부츠로 아래를 정돈해 컬러 포인트를 살려요.
copy.captionEn: Add one red scarf to a camel jacket and charcoal crew neck. Keep brown trousers and dark brown ankle boots quiet so the colour can lead.
copy.captionDe: Ergänze zur kamelfarbenen Jacke und zum anthrazitfarbenen Rundhals einen roten Schal. Braune Hose und dunkelbraune Stiefeletten lassen dem Farbakzent Raum.
copy.introKo: 카멜 울 재킷과 차콜 크루넥에 레드 머플러 하나를 더해요. 브라운 팬츠와 다크 브라운 앵클부츠로 아래를 정돈해 컬러 포인트를 살려요.
copy.introEn: Add one red scarf to a camel jacket and charcoal crew neck. Keep brown trousers and dark brown ankle boots quiet so the colour can lead.
copy.introDe: Ergänze zur kamelfarbenen Jacke und zum anthrazitfarbenen Rundhals einen roten Schal. Braune Hose und dunkelbraune Stiefeletten lassen dem Farbakzent Raum.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 이너의 색과 질감을 드러내요. 어깨와 소매는 자연스럽게 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to show the inner colour and texture. Keep shoulders and sleeves relaxed.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit Farbe und Struktur der inneren Lage sichtbar bleiben. Schultern und Ärmel sitzen locker.
products.altKo: 카멜 울 재킷 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: camel tan textured wool-look cropped hip-length single-breasted jacket, notch lapels, three dark front buttons, straight relaxed silhouette

products.descriptionKo: 니트의 목선과 커프를 아우터 밖으로 조금 드러내요. 밑단은 팬츠 위에 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Show a little neckline and cuff beyond the outer layer. Keep the hem neat above the trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige etwas Ausschnitt und Bündchen unter der äußeren Lage. Ordne den Saum über der Hose.
products.altKo: 차콜 크루넥 니트 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: dark charcoal heathered wool-look crew-neck sweater, ribbed cuffs and hem

products.descriptionKo: 바지통을 조이지 않고 자연스럽게 떨어뜨려요. 신발 윗부분이 드러나도록 밑단을 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the legs fall naturally and keep the hem clear enough to show the shoes.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die Hosenbeine locker fallen und ordne den Saum so, dass die Schuhe sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 브라운 슬랙스 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: dark brown tailored straight-leg trousers, matte smooth fabric, center crease

products.descriptionKo: 팬츠 밑단을 정돈해 앞코와 제품의 간결한 형태를 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Keep the trouser hem neat to reveal the toe and clean shape of the footwear.
products.descriptionDe: Ordne den Hosensaum, damit Schuhspitze und klare Form sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 다크 브라운 첼시 부츠 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair dark brown smooth leather-look ankle Chelsea boots, plain rounded almond toes, dark elastic side panels conservatively reconstructed, low dark heel

products.descriptionKo: 목에 느슨하게 둘러 끝을 자연스럽게 내려요. 아우터 위에서 색과 질감을 보여줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Drape loosely around the neck and let the ends fall naturally over the outer layer.
products.descriptionDe: Lege den Schal locker um den Hals und lasse die Enden natürlich über der Jacke fallen.
products.altKo: 레드 프린지 머플러 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: single vivid red lightweight wool-look rectangular scarf, short fine fringed ends, full scarf gently extended

products.descriptionKo: 가는 체인 하나로 마무리해요. 니트와 소매의 선을 가리지 않게 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Finish with one fine chain, keeping the knit and cuff lines clear.
products.descriptionDe: Ergänze eine feine Kette und halte Strick und Ärmelabschlüsse frei.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 체인 브레이슬릿 — 아이보리 배경의 단독 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: single delicate gold-tone linked chain bracelet without charms

reconstructionNotes: Visible details follow the existing source editorial. Hidden backs, full sleeves, closures, waistbands and opposite footwear are conservative reconstructions.
Materials describe visible appearance; brand, fibre composition, price and purchase URL are unverified.
Actual and feels-like temperature values are unknown. Chilly is the existing folder and app classification.
excludedItems: Food, cups, crockery, paper grocery bags and groceries are scene props, not outfit products.
